scope: Historical catch-up of six previously mined owned Ironwood transactions, not future-live detection or mining/confirmation latency.

verification.source: Existing actual testnet archive while local Prep follower ingests through read-only SSH to existing Zebra

limitations: Same six previously mined transactions repeated over three fresh namespaces per profile/SDK; correlated samples, not future-live latency.
Private consumer polls at0.100s; successful GraphQL probes pause0.050s; observations include polling bounds.
Source acquisition/mining/confirmation time excluded; native scan includes child startup on first call.
Timing compares local WSL paths/affinity, not VPS quotas or public ingress.
Reader binary built before the additive Prep build-info endpoint; query and operational startup path same measured source delta.
Profile results do not change published defaults.

controlledRecovery.scenario: Synthetic testnet-compatible source interruption and1569-block catch-up; no key or natural reorg.

resourceCohort.scope: Separate6-run candidate resource cohort; usr/bin/time accounts completed Node/native child job, excluding separately running PostgreSQL,Prep and follower. MaxRSS is largest process high-water, not summed concurrent memory.
